rendered.subject: Collaborative Instagram Post Proposal
rendered.body:
Hi Graza team,

We are a small Instagram content studio dedicated to crafting authentic and playful experiences for food lovers. We’d like to propose a collaborative Instagram post with you and Graza, built on the fact that Graza started Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) but also made sure to get into grocers like Whole Foods, Target, etc [P8]. You’ve cultivated a social content strategy that’s delightfully unconventional, featuring playful messaging and culinary-inspired imagery. Specifically, Graza’s social content, product design, and messaging are designed to be engaging and memorable, rather than overly formal [P7]. Dickieson estimated that Graza has added around 2,000 new social followers since launching the cans [P9]. We envision a collaborative post where you share a visually striking image of a new can, accompanied by a short, evocative caption that captures the essence of the product and the brand’s playful approach [P7]. Together, we could create a post that subtly reinforces the unique character of Graza and invites followers to engage with the brand’s storytelling [P9]. We’d love to hear your thoughts on this idea.

The BrandPilot team
